basic_details.job_title: IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.details: Candidates must also possess demonstrated research experience in at least two of the following areas: Application of AI/ML in hydrology; Physics-based or physics-guided data-driven modeling; Remote Sensing, GIS, and Surveying for Natural Disasters; Mathematical or hydrological modelling of water systems. Experience with numerical modelling, scientific programming, peer-reviewed publications, and strong communication skills are required.

salary_details.details: The appointment duration is 1 year, which is extendable based on satisfactory performance.

how_to_apply: Visit the official application portal using the link provided below.
Register and access the online application form for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position under advertisement OTH/13514/Advt0341.
Fill in all required educational, research, and personal details accurately.
Upload supporting documents, research publications, and relevant certificates as required by the portal.
Review the completed application form carefully before final submission.
Submit the application online on or before 20th October, 2026.
important_instructions: Merely meeting the minimum eligibility criteria will not guarantee shortlisting and/or appointment. A higher cutoff level may be used by the Institute during the screening process. The Institute reserves all rights not to call an applicant for a selection test or not to fill up the position without assigning any reason. Candidates who have submitted their doctoral thesis are eligible to apply subject to Institute rules.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow Important Dates
IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position in the Civil Engineering department under Prof. Vimal Mishra.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must also possess demonstrated research experience in at least two of the following areas: Application of AI/ML in hydrology; Physics-based or physics-guided data-driven modeling; Remote Sensing, GIS, and Surveying for Natural Disasters; Mathematical or hydrological modelling of water systems. Experience with numerical modelling, scientific programming, peer-reviewed publications, and strong communication skills are required.

rows.qualification_required: PhD in Civil Engineering, Earth Sciences, Water Resources Engineering, Hydrology, or a closely related field. Candidates who have submitted their doctoral thesis may apply, subject to Institute rules. Minimum 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow Salary
content_sections.text: The appointment duration is 1 year, which is extendable based on satisfactory performance.

A higher cutoff level may be used by the Institute during the screening process. The Institute reserves all rights not to call an applicant for a selection test or not to fill up the position without assigning any reason. Candidates who have submitted their doctoral thesis are eligible to apply subject to Institute rules.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment being conducted by IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: IIT Gandhinagar is recruiting for 1 temporary position of Post-Doctoral Fellow under advertisement number OTH/13514/Advt0341 in the Civil Engineering department.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 20th October, 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a PhD in Civil Engineering, Earth Sciences, Water Resources Engineering, Hydrology, or a closely related field, with minimum 60% from graduation onwards and 55% in class 10th and 12th. Candidates who have submitted their thesis may also apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 1,00,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official recruitment portal at http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/.

faq.question: Q8. What is the initial duration of the IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow appointment?
faq.answer: The duration of the appointment is 1 year, which is extendable based on satisfactory performance.
